questions.q: What two ways does this lesson give for reaching the Company Information page in Setup?
options: Type "Company Information" into Quick Find, or browse to it under Company Settings in the sidebar
It can only be reached by contacting Salesforce support
Only through the App Launcher, never through Setup
Only by installing a special AppExchange package
questions.explain: Company Information can be reached either via Quick Find search or by browsing to it under Company Settings in the Setup sidebar.

questions.q: What is the Organization ID, according to this lesson?
options: A unique 15-character identifier for that specific org, unique across every Salesforce org in existence
The username of the org's primary administrator
A random number that changes every day
The name of the Salesforce data center region only
questions.explain: The Organization ID is a unique, 15-character identifier specific to one org, useful for support cases and logs.

questions.q: What does the "Instance" field on Company Information tell you, per this lesson?
options: Which physical data center the org is hosted on (for example, NA212)
How many users are logged in right now
The org's monthly subscription cost
The org's current storage usage percentage
questions.explain: Instance identifies the physical data center hosting the org, such as NA212.

questions.q: Per this lesson, what should you check on the User Licenses table before creating a new user?
options: Whether Remaining Licenses for the needed license type is above zero
The org's Organization ID
The org's current time zone setting
The Data Storage table instead, which has no connection to user creation
questions.explain: The User Licenses table's Remaining Licenses column shows whether a license type has room for a new user before you try creating one.

questions.q: What does the Data Storage table on Company Information show, according to this lesson?
options: A breakdown of what's consuming the org's storage limit, by record type, with counts and sizes
A list of every user's individual password
The org's Organization Edition only
A history of every login attempt
questions.explain: The Data Storage table breaks down storage usage by record type (like Contacts or Opportunities), which is useful once storage warnings appear.
